item.title: Build an ESP32 Weather Station Theremin: A Photoresistor Music Instrument
item.description: Last weekend I set out to build a simple ESP32 weather station – the kind that logs ambient light and temperature – but somewhere between breadboarding the photoresistor and staring at an unused passive buzzer in my component box, the project evolved into something way cooler. Instead of just measuring light for a dashboard, I turned the sensor readings into pitch changes and built a rudimentary electronic theremin. The result is a smart weather station ESP32 that doubles as a musical instrument, all managed with ESPHome.
